Summary: CH-S01 Campus signup tenants and plan gates
Description:

As a campus owner I can sign up a tenant and stay on a plan with feature gates.

h3. Acceptance
* Free vs Campus gates apply (Ask AI model vs catalog text seats).
* Seeded users still sign in with CampusHub!123.

As a campus admin I can invite people and manage the People list.

h3. Acceptance

* People page lists campus members.

As a campus admin I can see mock billing and change plan without a real PSP.

Description:

As a platform admin I use /ops; as a campus owner I use /campus.

h3. Acceptance
* Admin reaches Razor ops at /ops.
* Campus console is separate from platform ops.

Summary: CH-S08 Chat rooms and AI tutor
Description:

As a student I can chat in a course room and ask the tutor from the player.

specs/010-chat-ai-tutor/spec.md

Description:

As a student I can filter sort and see recommended courses.

h3. Acceptance
* Catalog query params filter and sort the list.

specs/011-catalog-discovery/spec.md

As a student I see streak progress bars and continue-learning on My learning.

h3. Spec
specs/012-progress-dashboard/spec.md

As a teacher I author a quiz; as a student I attempt it in the player.

h3. Acceptance
* Teacher can add a multiple-choice quiz on edit course.

specs/013-quizzes/spec.md

As a teacher I create written assignments and grade them; as a student I submit.
